topic.symptom: Pressing the case power button does nothing at all.
topic.title: Power Button Does Nothing? Check the Front-Panel Pins

script: Power button does nothing? Check the front-panel pins. The button's two-pin plug goes on the power switch pins. Your motherboard manual shows the layout.

storyboard.title: Power Button Does Nothing? Check the Front-Panel Pins
storyboard.narrationStyle: Calm, conversational, one check; proposed narration only (no voice generated).

beats.visualDirection: A finger presses the stylized PC's button; nothing lights.
Close on the bottom-right of the motherboard: a small header with two pins glowing amber.

beats.narration: The button's two-pin plug goes on the power switch pins.
beats.visualDirection: The 'POWER SW' plug slides onto the two pins.

beats.narration: Your motherboard manual shows the layout.
beats.visualDirection: A manual page icon with a pin diagram, 'example only: check your board'.

storyboard.finalCta: Save this for your next build.
factualGuardrails: Never say: guaranteed cure for dead power buttons (It may not work; one check, never a guaranteed fix.)
persistentDisclosures: Stylized example · not a fix for every PC

mechanism.why: no trusted approval record exists in this repository: a caller-supplied reviewer name and time is recorded, but does not prove anyone watched or listened, so it cannot close the gate. A decision is recorded with the bytes and cut it names; an approval never closes a gate, and a recorded rejection always blocks.

gates.question: Watched on a phone at real size: is the hook understood within the first two seconds?
Is the factual takeaway understood correctly, with no misleading emphasis, after one watch?
Are all text, numbers and game names readable at real size, inside the visible area?
Is the pacing intentional: no rushed line, no dead air, and every cut lands on its line?
Does the style suit a beginner choosing a gaming PC?
After a full listen: is every word pronounced correctly, and is the mix clear?
Is each disclosure understandable in context, while the claim it qualifies is on screen?
Are the rights to every asset signed off, and is publication of this exact cut authorised?
